missions.title: Welcome to Quantum Odyssey
missions.objective: Recognize that money choices involve tradeoffs.
missions.parentPrompt: Why did you choose that option?
missions.teacherNote: Encourage the learner to explain the reason behind the choice rather than focusing only on the outcome.

missions.title: Needs vs. Wants
missions.objective: Distinguish common needs from discretionary wants and explain the reasoning.
missions.parentPrompt: Can something be both a need and a want? Explain.
missions.teacherNote: Accept reasonable explanations because context can change whether something is a need or want.

missions.title: Build Your First Budget
missions.objective: Allocate a limited amount of money among spending, saving, and a goal.
missions.parentPrompt: What would you change if you had five more coins?
missions.teacherNote: Focus on reasoning, tradeoffs, and the relationship between present spending and future goals.
